name: latex_superscript
description: Produce LaTeX exponent syntax after a supplied base; matched controls produce LaTeX subscript syntax after the same base.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];controls=[]
p='Use LaTeX with braces.\nx to the power of 2: x^{2}\ny to the power of 7: y^{7}\n'
cp='Use LaTeX with braces.\nx with subscript 2: x_{2}\ny with subscript 7: y_{7}\n'
for i in range(120):
 v=random.choice(list('abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz'));n=random.randint(2,99)
 items.append({'prompt':p+f'{v} to the power of {n}: {v}','answer':'^{'+str(n)+'}'})
 controls.append({'prompt':cp+f'{v} with subscript {n}: {v}','answer':'_{'+str(n)+'}'})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
